subject: Aligning exec coverage for CloudTide demo — CIO attendance and fallback
snippet: Confirming whether CIO/CTO need to attend — proposing delegate coverage and finalizing calendar
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudtide.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: Aiden Brooks <aiden.b@cloudtide.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Executive intro + demo: request for CIO attendance

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the intro earlier. We at CloudTide are excited to see Redwood's inference runtime in action. Would your CIO or CTO be available for a short (30–40 min) executive-level demo and discussion the week of Aug 17? Our CIO would like to attend if possible — high level: economics, reliability, and deployment modes (VPC/on-prem).

Preferred windows: Tue Aug 18 10:00–11:00 PT or Thu Aug 20 11:00–12:00 PT. If neither works, we can propose alternate dates. Also attaching a one-pager on our initiative so you have context.

Attachments: CloudTide_Redesign-Initiative_onepager.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Samira Khan
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudTide Systems
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudtide.com>
Cc: Aiden Brooks <aiden.b@cloudtide.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive intro + demo: request for CIO attendance

Hi Samira — great to connect. Thanks for the windows.

Ben — looping you in for exec coverage. Our CTO (Irene) has limited availability that week; if CIO/CTO attendance is a hard requirement we'll prioritize, otherwise we can run a focused exec briefing + deep technical follow-up with our platform/infra leads.

Samira — for prioritization, is the ask primarily an executive-level product walk + SLOs/SLAs talk, or is the CIO expecting a technical deep-dives into deployment patterns? That will determine whether we need Irene or whether Ben/Karthik can cover.

I can do Thu Aug 20 11:00 PT if that works for your CIO.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Executive intro + demo: request for CIO attendance

Grace — quick internal note on exec coverage:

- If CloudTide's CIO wants a high-level exec conversation (economics, SLAs, account strategy), I can lead as VP sales.
- For deployment specifics (VPC, KMS/HSM, on-prem install constraints) Karthik should be on the call as platform lead.
- Irene — can you pencil in Thu Aug 20 11:00 PT as tentative? If you can't make it, Karthik can present technical posture and we'll follow-up with a short CTO technical readout later.

Suggested plan: 25m exec walkthrough (Ben + Grace), 20m technical Q&A (Karthik), follow-up doc + SOW draft to be shared. I've attached the latest Redwood exec brief slides for the CloudTide use-case.

Attachments: Redwood-exec-brief-slides.pdf (pdf)

Thanks,
Ben
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudtide.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc: Aiden Brooks <aiden.b@cloudtide.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive intro + demo: request for CIO attendance

Thanks — quick update: our CIO's schedule just shifted and he is not available on Aug 18 or Aug 20. He asked if the demo could happen Mon Aug 24 or Fri Aug 27, but he also said it's OK for a senior exec + CTO to attend in his stead if we can lock a short follow-up with him the week after.

I attached a draft SOW and an internal goals doc so you can see scope. We prefer Aug 20 originally but can pivot to Aug 27 if that helps.

Attachments: SOW-CloudTide-draft.docx, CloudTide_OpsGoals_v1.pdf

Regards,
Samira
Head of Platform Partnerships
CloudTide Systems
From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudtide.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Aug 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Executive intro + demo: request for CIO attendance

Samira — thanks for the heads up and for the SOW draft. Aug 27 will work on our side but we have a hard blocker that day from 9–10am PT. Can we do Thu Aug 20 at 11:00 PT after all? Ben and I can lead the executive portion and Karthik will own the technical Q&A; Irene will be invited as backup/CTO-level observer, and we can schedule a 30-minute follow-up with your CIO the following week (Aug 31–Sep 2).

If Aug 20 is still problematic, let's lock Aug 27 at 11:00 PT. Either way, please confirm attendee list so we can finalize the invite.

Proposed attendees from Redwood: Grace O'Connor (Head of Sales), Ben Carter (VP, Strategic Accounts), Karthik Iyer (Platform Lead). Please add any CloudTide stakeholders beyond the CIO.

Also sharing our mutual-action plan PDF for internal alignment. I'll update HubSpot and send a DocuSign link for the NDA redline you asked about.

Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/4832
Attachments: CloudTide_MutualActionPlan_v2.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Grace
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@cloudtide.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Redwood x CloudTide demo — Thu Aug 20 11:00 PT (calendar invite sent)

Samira — locking in Thu Aug 20 at 11:00 PT. Calendar invite sent to the list; please accept when you get it.

Agenda (30–40 min)
- 0:00–0:05 Quick intros + outcomes
- 0:05–0:25 Exec walkthrough (Ben + Grace): economics, routing/fallback, deployment surface
- 0:25–0:45 Technical Q&A (Karthik): VPC/on‑prem patterns, KMS integration, latency profiles

Deliverables after the demo: updated SOW draft, short technical appendix, and an exec one-pager for your CIO. I attached the mutual action plan for reference.

Attachments: CloudTide_MutualActionPlan_v2.pdf

Thanks everyone — looking forward to it.

Ben Carter
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
